title: Android Exported Component Intent Redirection
platform_conditions: Android runtime (API level 1+; component export semantics tightened in Android 12 / API 31, which requires an explicit android:exported declaration)
security_mechanism: An exported Activity/Service/Receiver is invokable by any app on the device. A common redirection pattern reads an Intent (or a URI) out of the incoming Intent's extras and hands it to startActivity()/sendBroadcast()/bindService() without checking the embedded component. A malicious app then supplies an explicit Intent targeting one of YOUR privileged non-exported components, or carrying extras those components trust; because the forwarding app is the caller of record, the privileged component's permission and identity checks pass even though the payload originated from the attacker. Mutable PendingIntents (FLAG_MUTABLE absent) have the same shape: the filling app can rewrite the wrapped Intent's extras before it fires.

source_sink_clues.source: An attacker-controlled Intent delivered to the exported component: extras, the embedded Intent object itself, or a deep-link URI parsed from it.
source_sink_clues.sink: startActivity/getParcelableExtra("forward")-style forwarding to startActivity(), startActivityForResult(), sendBroadcast(), bindService(); PendingIntent.getActivity/getBroadcast with a non-immutable (FLAG_IMMUTABLE missing) wrapped Intent

tracking_guards: Check the forwarded Intent is validated before use: its component/class compared against an allowlist, its action/data URI scheme checked, extras re-validated, and the wrapper PendingIntent created with FLAG_IMMUTABLE; check the manifest marks components non-exported unless externally reachable (android:exported="false" or the absence of intent-filters on internal components); check the component sets Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_EXCLUDE_FROM_RECENTS or otherwise defends when forwarding is genuinely required.
not_candidate_when: The component is not exported (no intent-filter and android:exported="false"), so no other app can deliver the Intent; the forwarded Intent is constructed entirely inside the app from validated fields; or the embedded Intent is resolved against a fixed allowlist of in-app components before startActivity is called.
public_references: CWE-926: Improper Export of Android Application Components — https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/926.html
CWE-927: Use of Implicit Intent for Sensitive Communication — https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/927.html
